title: HEAL AND ARMOUR LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps headline with a short detail only when needed, never a sentence. The heal and armour lines that were still sentences now read that way: NO STIM INJECTOR LEFT, STIM INJECTOR ACTIVE with 10s of unlimited stamina (the seconds come from the stim itself), STIM INJECTOR WORE OFF, SELF-REVIVE USED with Back on your feet, PATCHED UP, and for a teammate PATCHED UP KITE, PLATE SLOTTED FOR KITE, KITE PATCHED YOU UP, PLATE FROM KITE with your armour, KITE MOVED AWAY and KITE ALREADY HEALING with the item kept as the detail. A Bandage healing over time no longer says Bandage is healing you, 2 sec, because the status icon on the left already shows HEALING and its seconds. His Self-revive spent line is unchanged.
now: Heal, stim, self-revive and teammate aid lines read as short caps callouts, and a heal over time shows on its status icon instead of a line.
